fon-sat-1.webp.zh: 卫星视角：拉福图纳机场位于红圈处，周围是哥斯达黎加的雨林与农田。
fon-sat-1.webp.en: Satellite view: La Fortuna airport is circled in red, surrounded by rainforest and farmland in Costa Rica.

fon-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 航拍视角下，标着 24 的跑道穿过成片绿野，红顶小屋与绿色机库聚在跑道尽头，远处是雨林与山脉。
fon-chatgpt-01.webp.en: In the aerial view, a runway marked 24 cuts through green fields, with a red-roofed building and a green hangar clustered at one end and rainforest and mountains beyond.

fon-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 日落时分，一架红白涂装的单发小飞机停在标有 FON 的跑道上，火山在晚霞中隆起成剪影。
fon-chatgpt-02.webp.en: At sunset a red and white single-engine aircraft waits on the runway marked FON, while a huge volcano rises as a dark cone under a glowing sky.

fon-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 白色涡桨小飞机带着“SANSA”字样滑行在跑道上，锥形火山在它身后直插云天。
fon-chatgpt-03.webp.en: A white single-engine turboprop marked SANSA taxis along the runway, with a steep conical volcano rising behind it into a pale sky.

fon-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 画面左侧是螺旋桨与发动机整流罩的特写，前方空旷的停机坪尽头，一座火山伏在云层之下。
fon-chatgpt-04.webp.en: A propeller spinner and engine cowling fill the left foreground, beyond them an empty apron stretches toward a volcano sitting beneath banks of cumulus clouds.

fon-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 白色双发涡桨飞机涂着“NatureAir”字样，停在草地边，橙色锥筒立在两侧，火山在远处。
fon-chatgpt-05.webp.en: A white twin-engine turboprop wearing NatureAir titles stands at the grass edge with orange cones beside it, a distant volcano fading into the haze.

fon-chatgpt-06.webp.zh: 一架白色单发涡桨飞机放下起落架，低低地掠过树梢，正准备降落在雨林间的这条跑道上。
fon-chatgpt-06.webp.en: A white single-engine turboprop approaches with its wheels down, skimming low over the treetops as it comes in to land on the forest-lined runway.

fon-chatgpt-07.webp.zh: 旅客背着包在停机坪上排成一列走开，地勤拿着记录板站在“SANSA”飞机旁，火山隐在云雾中。
fon-chatgpt-07.webp.en: Passengers with backpacks file away across the apron while a ground agent with a clipboard stands by a plane marked SANSA, with a volcano veiled in cloud behind.
